== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ガダフィの杖</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して タスケン・レイダーに配備する。起動にフォースを必要としない。その場で戦闘が始まった場合 即座に運命数を2枚引く。2枚の運命数の合計＞5ならば、敵は武器を“はじき飛ばされて” この戦闘では使えなくなる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">“ガッフィ”とも呼ばれる、タスケン・レイダーの好む武器。廃棄された金属などで作られる。相手を脅し、恐怖させるに十分な武器である。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Gaderffii Stick]].

'''Lore''' — A weapon favored by Tusken Raiders, also called a “gaffi.” Made from discarded metal. It is enough to threaten and frighten an opponent.

'''Game text''' — Use 2 Force to deploy on a Tusken Raider. No Force is required to fire it. If a battle begins there, immediately draw two destiny. If their total is greater than 5, the enemy’s weapons are knocked away and cannot be used in this battle.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Activating requires no Force rather than “may target for free”. A battle 始まった場合 rather than “has just been initiated where present”. White border.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-gaderffiistick-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Gaderffii Stick]].</ref>
